Put Handle(request) and SetNext(handler: IHandler) on IHandler. EnemyHandler implements IHandler, stores the next handler, and supplies public SetNext and protected forward.

OrcHandler, GoblinHandler, and TrollHandler extend EnemyHandler. Each implements its own Handle(request) and calls forward on a mismatch. SilkThread uses IHandler and calls Handle on its single handler reference.
Use the Passes to arrows between concrete handlers: OrcHandler → GoblinHandler → TrollHandler. TrollHandler has no next handler.
